regions.title: Overall Progress Position
regions.presentation_notes: Three horizontal KPI cards: cumulative planned, cumulative actual and progress variance. Previous-week cumulative planned comparison is unavailable because the baseline planned series has no 24-Sep-2026 observation; null is preserved, not zero-filled. Current actual reporting period is a partial 3-day period and is qualified. No interpolation or invented comparison.

regions.title: Executive Schedule Position
regions.presentation_notes: Four horizontal KPI cards: forecast completion date, current project delay, critical activity count and schedule status. Critical activity count is unchanged week-on-week at 2,257 and is not by itself evidence of schedule improvement. Delayed schedule status is preserved from source.

regions.title: Cumulative Planned vs Actual Progress
regions.presentation_notes: Line chart uses separate verified period-end dates for planned and actual series. Irregular observation dates and null gaps are preserved. Only the 27-Sep-2026 planned and actual cumulative values are directly comparable. No resampling, interpolation or zero substitution; baseline periods after the data date are not plotted.

regions.title: Weekly Planned vs Actual Progress and Variance
regions.presentation_notes: Two independent mini-charts side by side within one panel: WGT-009 weekly planned vs actual percentage-point grouped bars; WGT-010 weekly planned vs actual variance percentage-point grouped bars. Separate titles, captions, legends and datasets are retained. Confirmed zeros remain zero; W54 partial period and baseline/reporting week mapping are qualified. No merged dataset or new variance calculation.

regions.title: Progress by Phase
regions.presentation_notes: Eight phase categories plotted in source order with planned and actual groups. Use compact phase-code labels where space requires. Supplied zero values are preserved. Unresolved phase names remain original codes. Variance is not plotted as a chart series.

regions.title: Trade Schedule Comparison
regions.presentation_notes: Eight-trade comparative Gantt selected from 29 authoritative trade records. Planned bars use lavender/violet and actual/progress markers use mint. Shared chronological date axis with Data Date reference at 27-Sep-2026. Compact trade labels and legend; reduce row padding and label length before reducing displayed trades. Actual finish dates for in-progress trades are labelled as latest verified activity actual finish, not overall trade completion. No forecast trade finish dates were supplied or inferred.

Do not invent activities, critical/driving classifications, float values, dates or urgency. When authoritative data is available, limit to six verified critical/driving activities.
